verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: קַדֶּשׁ־ לִ֨י כָל־ בְּכ֜וֹר פֶּ֤טֶר כָּל־ רֶ֙חֶם֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֽוּא׃ לִ֖י בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: qad·deš- lî ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr pe·ṭer kāl- re·ḥem biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl hū lî bā·’ā·ḏām ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh
verses.literal: Consecrate to Me every firstborn male The firstborn from every womb among the Israelites . . . belongs to Me [both] of man and beast

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ הָעָ֗ם זָכ֞וֹר אֶת־ הַזֶּה֙ הַיּ֤וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְצָאתֶ֤ם מִמִּצְרַ֙יִם֙ מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים כִּ֚י יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הוֹצִ֧יא מִזֶּ֑ה בְּחֹ֣זֶק יָ֔ד וְלֹ֥א חָמֵֽץ׃ יֵאָכֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh way·yō·mer ’el- hā·‘ām zā·ḵō·wr ’eṯ- haz·zeh hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer yə·ṣā·ṯem mim·miṣ·ra·yim mib·bêṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm kî Yah·weh ’eṯ·ḵem hō·w·ṣî miz·zeh bə·ḥō·zeq yāḏ wə·lō ḥā·mêṣ yê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: So Moses told . . . the people Remember - this day [the day] you came out of Egypt out of the house of slavery for the LORD - brought you out of it by the strength of His hand And nothing leavened shall be eaten

verses.original: הַיּ֖וֹם בְּחֹ֖דֶשׁ הָאָבִֽיב׃ אַתֶּ֣ם יֹצְאִ֑ים
verses.transliteration: hay·yō·wm bə·ḥō·ḏeš hā·’ā·ḇîḇ ’at·tem yō·ṣə·’îm
verses.literal: Today in the month of Abib you are leaving

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה כִֽי־ יְהוָ֡ה יְבִֽיאֲךָ֣ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽ֠כְּנַעֲנִי וְהַחִתִּ֨י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֜י וְהַחִוִּ֣י וְהַיְבוּסִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֣תֶת לָ֔ךְ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ וְעָבַדְתָּ֛ אֶת־ הַזֹּ֖את הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה הַזֶּֽה׃ בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵî- Yah·weh yə·ḇî·’ă·ḵā ’el- ’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lā·ṯeṯ lāḵ ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš wə·‘ā·ḇaḏ·tā ’eṯ- haz·zōṯ hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh haz·zeh ba·ḥō·ḏeš
verses.literal: And when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites Hittites Amorites Hivites and Jebusites [the land] He swore to your fathers that He would give you a land flowing with milk and honey you shall keep - this service in this month

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תֹּאכַ֣ל מַצֹּ֑ת הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבַיּוֹם֙ חַ֖ג לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm tō·ḵal maṣ·ṣōṯ haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ū·ḇay·yō·wm ḥaḡ Yah·weh
verses.literal: For seven days you are to eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day there shall be a feast to the LORD

verses.original: מַצּוֹת֙ יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ חָמֵ֗ץ יֵרָאֶ֨ה לְךָ֜ וְלֹֽא־ שְׂאֹ֖ר יֵרָאֶ֥ה בְּכָל־ לְךָ֛ גְּבֻלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: maṣ·ṣō·wṯ yê·’ā·ḵêl ’êṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm wə·lō- ḥā·mêṣ yê·rā·’eh lə·ḵā wə·lō- śə·’ōr yê·rā·’eh bə·ḵāl lə·ḵā gə·ḇu·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Unleavened bread shall be eaten - during those seven days Nothing leavened may be found among you nor shall leaven be found anywhere within your borders

verses.original: הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹ֑ר בַּיּ֥וֹם וְהִגַּדְתָּ֣ לְבִנְךָ֔ בַּעֲב֣וּר זֶ֗ה יְהוָה֙ עָשָׂ֤ה לִ֔י בְּצֵאתִ֖י מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū lê·mōr bay·yō·wm wə·hig·gaḏ·tā lə·ḇin·ḵā ba·‘ă·ḇūr zeh Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh lî bə·ṣê·ṯî mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: And on that . . . day you are to explain to your son This is because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ לְא֜וֹת לְךָ֨ עַל־ יָדְךָ֗ וּלְזִכָּרוֹן֙ בֵּ֣ין עֵינֶ֔יךָ לְמַ֗עַן תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֛ה בְּפִ֑יךָ כִּ֚י חֲזָקָ֔ה בְּיָ֣ד יְהֹוָ֖ה הוֹצִֽאֲךָ֥ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lə·’ō·wṯ lə·ḵā ‘al- yā·ḏə·ḵā ū·lə·zik·kā·rō·wn bên ‘ê·ne·ḵā lə·ma·‘an tō·w·raṯ Yah·weh tih·yeh bə·p̄î·ḵā kî ḥă·zā·qāh bə·yāḏ Yah·weh hō·w·ṣi·’ă·ḵā mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: It shall be a sign for you on your hand and a reminder on your forehead . . . that the Law of the LORD is to be on your lips For with a mighty hand the LORD brought you out of Egypt

verses.original: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֛ אֶת־ הַזֹּ֖את הַחֻקָּ֥ה לְמוֹעֲדָ֑הּ מִיָּמִ֖ים יָמִֽימָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mar·tā ’eṯ- haz·zōṯ ha·ḥuq·qāh lə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏāh mî·yā·mîm yā·mî·māh
verses.literal: Therefore you shall keep - this statute at the appointed time year after year

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּֽי־ יְהוָה֙ יְבִֽאֲךָ֤ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וּנְתָנָ֖הּ לָֽךְ׃ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְךָ֖ וְלַֽאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- Yah·weh yə·ḇi·’ă·ḵā ’el- ’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ū·nə·ṯā·nāh lāḵ ka·’ă·šer niš·ba‘ lə·ḵā wə·la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: And after the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites and gives it to you as He swore to you and your fathers

verses.original: וְהַעֲבַרְתָּ֥ לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה פֶּֽטֶר־ כָל־ רֶ֖חֶם וְכָל־ פֶּ֣טֶר׀ שֶׁ֣גֶר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַזְּכָרִ֖ים יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ בְּהֵמָ֗ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·‘ă·ḇar·tā Yah·weh pe·ṭer- ḵāl re·ḥem wə·ḵāl pe·ṭer še·ḡer ’ă·šer haz·zə·ḵā·rîm yih·yeh lə·ḵā bə·hê·māh Yah·weh
verses.literal: you are to present to the LORD the firstborn male of every womb All the firstborn . . . - males of your . . . livestock [belong to] the LORD

verses.original: תִּפְדֶּ֣ה וְכָל־ פֶּ֤טֶר חֲמֹר֙ בְשֶׂ֔ה וְאִם־ לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה וַעֲרַפְתּ֑וֹ וְכֹ֨ל בְּכ֥וֹר אָדָ֛ם בְּבָנֶ֖יךָ תִּפְדֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tip̄·deh wə·ḵāl pe·ṭer ḥă·mōr ḇə·śeh wə·’im- lō ṯip̄·deh wa·‘ă·rap̄·tōw wə·ḵōl bə·ḵō·wr ’ā·ḏām bə·ḇā·ne·ḵā tip̄·deh
verses.literal: You must redeem every firstborn donkey with a lamb and if you do not redeem it you are to break its neck And every firstborn . . . of your sons you must redeem

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה מָחָ֖ר כִּֽי־ בִנְךָ֛ יִשְׁאָלְךָ֥ מַה־ זֹּ֑את לֵאמֹ֣ר וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֔יו בְּחֹ֣זֶק יָ֗ד יְהוָ֛ה הוֹצִיאָ֧נוּ מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh mā·ḥār kî- ḇin·ḵā yiš·’ā·lə·ḵā mah- zōṯ lê·mōr wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw bə·ḥō·zeq yāḏ Yah·weh hō·w·ṣî·’ā·nū mim·miṣ·ra·yim mib·bêṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm
verses.literal: - In the future when your son asks you What does this mean you are to tell him With a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt out of the house of slavery

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּֽי־ פַרְעֹה֮ הִקְשָׁ֣ה לְשַׁלְּחֵנוּ֒ יְהֹוָ֤ה וַיַּהֲרֹ֨ג כָּל־ בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִבְּכֹ֥ר אָדָ֖ם וְעַד־ בְּכ֣וֹר בְּהֵמָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּן֩ אֲנִ֨י זֹבֵ֜חַ לַֽיהוָ֗ה פֶּ֤טֶר הַזְּכָרִ֔ים כָּל־ רֶ֙חֶם֙ אֶפְדֶּֽה׃ וְכָל־ בְּכ֥וֹר בָּנַ֖י
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî- p̄ar·‘ōh hiq·šāh lə·šal·lə·ḥê·nū Yah·weh way·ya·hă·rōḡ kāl- bə·ḵō·wr bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mib·bə·ḵōr ’ā·ḏām wə·‘aḏ- bə·ḵō·wr bə·hê·māh ‘al- kên ’ă·nî zō·ḇê·aḥ Yah·weh pe·ṭer haz·zə·ḵā·rîm kāl- re·ḥem ’ep̄·deh wə·ḵāl bə·ḵō·wr bā·nay
verses.literal: And when Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go the LORD killed every firstborn in the land of Egypt both of man and - beast This is why . . . I sacrifice to the LORD the firstborn male of every womb but I redeem all the firstborn of my sons

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה לְאוֹת֙ עַל־ יָ֣דְכָ֔ה וּלְטוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֣ין עֵינֶ֑יךָ כִּ֚י בְּחֹ֣זֶק יָ֔ד יְהוָ֖ה הוֹצִיאָ֥נוּ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh lə·’ō·wṯ ‘al- yā·ḏə·ḵāh ū·lə·ṭō·w·ṭā·p̄ōṯ bên ‘ê·ne·ḵā kî bə·ḥō·zeq yāḏ Yah·weh hō·w·ṣî·’ā·nū mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So it shall serve as a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead . . . for with a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י פַּרְעֹה֮ אֶת־ הָעָם֒ בְּשַׁלַּ֣ח אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְלֹא־ נָחָ֣ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים כִּ֥י ה֑וּא קָר֖וֹב כִּ֣י׀ אֱלֹהִ֗ים פֶּֽן־ אָמַ֣ר בִּרְאֹתָ֥ם מִלְחָמָ֖ה הָעָ֛ם יִנָּחֵ֥ם וְשָׁ֥בוּ מִצְרָֽיְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî par·‘ōh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bə·šal·laḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·lō- nā·ḥām de·reḵ ’e·reṣ pə·liš·tîm kî hū qā·rō·wḇ kî ’ĕ·lō·hîm pen- ’ā·mar bir·’ō·ṯām mil·ḥā·māh hā·‘ām yin·nā·ḥêm wə·šā·ḇū miṣ·rā·yə·māh
verses.literal: - When Pharaoh - let the people go God did not lead them along the road through the land of the Philistines though it was shorter For God . . . said If [the people] face war [they] might change their minds and return to Egypt

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ הָעָ֛ם וַיַּסֵּ֨ב דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר אֶת־ ס֑וּף יַם־ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָל֥וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃ וַחֲמֻשִׁ֛ים
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm hā·‘ām way·yas·sêḇ de·reḵ ham·miḏ·bār ’eṯ- sūp̄ yam- ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ā·lū mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wa·ḥă·mu·šîm
verses.literal: So God led the people around by the way of the wilderness - toward the Red Sea And the Israelites . . . left the land of Egypt arrayed for battle

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ וַיִּקַּ֥ח עַצְמ֥וֹת יוֹסֵ֖ף עִמּ֑וֹ כִּי֩ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַשְׁבֵּ֨עַ הִשְׁבִּ֜יעַ אֶת־ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֱלֹהִים֙ פָּקֹ֨ד יִפְקֹ֤ד אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְהַעֲלִיתֶ֧ם אֶת־ עַצְמֹתַ֛י אִתְּכֶֽם׃ מִזֶּ֖ה
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·yiq·qaḥ ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ yō·w·sêp̄ ‘im·mōw kî bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl haš·bê·a‘ hiš·bî·a‘ ’eṯ- lê·mōr ’ĕ·lō·hîm pā·qōḏ yip̄·qōḏ ’eṯ·ḵem wə·ha·‘ă·lî·ṯem ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·ṯay ’it·tə·ḵem miz·zeh
verses.literal: Moses - took the bones of Joseph with him because {Joseph had made} the sons of Israel swear a solemn oath . . . - when he said God will surely attend to . . . you and then you must carry - my bones with you from this place

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִסֻּכֹּ֑ת וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בְאֵתָ֔ם בִּקְצֵ֖ה הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mis·suk·kōṯ way·ya·ḥă·nū ḇə·’ê·ṯām biq·ṣêh ham·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the wilderness

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֡ה הֹלֵךְ֩ לִפְנֵיהֶ֨ם בְּעַמּ֤וּד עָנָן֙ לַנְחֹתָ֣ם הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ יוֹמָ֜ם בְּעַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ לְהָאִ֣יר לָהֶ֑ם וְלַ֛יְלָה לָלֶ֖כֶת יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hō·lêḵ lip̄·nê·hem bə·‘am·mūḏ ‘ā·nān lan·ḥō·ṯām had·de·reḵ yō·w·mām bə·‘am·mūḏ ’êš lə·hā·’îr lā·hem wə·lay·lāh lā·le·ḵeṯ yō·w·mām wā·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: And the LORD went before them in a pillar of cloud to guide their way by day and in a pillar of fire to give them light . . . by night so that they could travel by day or night

verses.original: לֹֽא־ עַמּ֤וּד הֶֽעָנָן֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְעַמּ֥וּד הָאֵ֖שׁ לָ֑יְלָה יָמִ֞ישׁ לִפְנֵ֖י הָעָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō- ‘am·mūḏ he·‘ā·nān yō·w·mām wə·‘am·mūḏ hā·’êš lā·yə·lāh yā·mîš lip̄·nê hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place before the people
